ground_plane — DRIVE walkterrain op

• Datenarten: depth → depth

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ground_plane(grid, trim: 'float' = 0.3, iters: 'int' = 3) (die Implementierung direkt: import terrain; terrain.ground_plane(grid, trim: 'float' = 0.3, iters: 'int' = 3); aus dem Register: opsdrive.get("ground_plane"))

• GPU: nein (nur CPU-Referenzimplementierung)

Verwendung

Robuste Kleinste-Quadrate-Bodenebene z = a·x + b·y + c je Zelle.

> Die ausführliche Beschreibung unten ist der Originaltext — Zusammenfassung und Überschriften sind übersetzt.

Fits a plane to the (filled) elevation, then re-fits a few times after trimming the highest-residual cells — the ones that rise above the ground and are therefore obstacles, not ground. Recovers a flat *or* tilted (ramp) ground exactly, with no boundary artefact, which is what obstacle detection wants when the walkable surface is planar. *trim* is the top residual fraction discarded each iteration.

空の入力(grid が 0 要素)は形を保った空の配列を返す(理由: 当てはめる高さが無く、形だけを保つ。観測が 3 セル未満の地図は nan の平面)。
